profile.headline: iOS Developer
profile.summary: I have been developing on the iOS platform since October 2014 in Swift and Objective-C.  With a background in customer service, I am uniquely suited for working on a team and with clients.  My passion for people and technology inspires me to pursue the collaborative creation of valuable software.  In the workplace, I make people feel valued and cared for.  Co-workers and managers enjoy my presence, along with my insatiable desire to learn.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Building the My H-E-B iOS app

positions.title: Software Engineer (iOS)
positions.description:
- Deployed new features and bug fixes weekly, ensuring an enhanced user experience for Grailed's platform.
- Conducted comprehensive unit testing for all developed features and fixes, guaranteeing robust and error-free code.
- Proficiently utilized technologies including UIKit, Swift UI, Rx Swift, The Composable Architecture, Quick & Nimble, feature flagging, and analytics.
- Engineered developer-centric enhancements such as the implementation of a duplicate call detection banner for dev builds and the strategic refactoring of authentication into the networking layer, thus decoupling it from the current app user object.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: This was a contract to hire role via Kforce. I was one of 3 iOS developers working on the ReachNow Car and Ride Sharing application. We worked in SCRUM style sprints to deliver new features and fix bugs. Design, product, external developers and a great backend team collaborated on a daily basis to build an app that served thousands of users.

positions.title: iOS Developer (volunteer)
positions.description: Recruited and managed a team to build official mobile apps for Seattle Parks & Recreation Department. This is now an open-source project that will provide an iOS and Android app to the city. My team and I have built a commercial quality iOS app for the department that will greatly improve trail use and issue reporting. We have included accessibility information like surface types and incline to better serve citizens with disabilities.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Create and ship client customizations of the iWM(Informer Work Management) and iIM (Informer Inventory Management) framework iOS apps.
Continue building on and maintaining the current versions of iIM and iWM, which I helped create on a small team of developers using SCRUM sprints and Git Flow.
Leverage SQL to interrogate data for use in our mobile apps.
Provide production support for mobile applications.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Developing an iOS app in Swift and a Node.JS server with a start up team to make an exciting new service that will improve gift giving. https://www.cudos.com/

positions.title: Lead iOS Developer
positions.description: Created an app from the ground up that teaches filmmaking by enabling people to do a lot of it. With the right constraints, the app makes it easy to shoot and produce 30 second movies. This was built with Swift 2, AVFoundation and Photos Framework. Get it on the App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1085805260

positions.title: Pest Management Professional
positions.description:
- Managed and grew a large service route. This included scheduling, record keeping and communication with every customer prior to arriving on site for service.
- Successfully retained upset customers, on multiple occasions, with expectation management and effective communication.
- Received written accolades from customers.

positions.title: Seeker
positions.description:
During this time I flipped foreclosures with my wife, started a small business and failed, tried my hand at sales for US Merchant Services and Worldmark by Wyndham, and began studying programming.

After finding out that sales was not for me, and needing to generate more income, I reentered the Pest Control industry. During this time, I used my experience in searching for a career to decide on one and researched options for entry. This lead to my absolute commitment to programming, and a start with Code Fellows in October 2014.

Prior to this, I had never done the hard work of figuring out what I want to do long term. A good career has several important elements: liking what you do, the work being valuable to others, and a clear vision of growth. Having found all of these in programming, I am now firmly committed to this path.

“You have to be burning with an idea, or a problem, or a wrong that you want to right. If you're not passionate enough from the start, you'll never stick it out.” 
― Steve Jobs

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description:
- Managed access to site via advanced security computer system. 
- Patrolled Russell floors every hour.
- Coordinated with building security for expanded situational awareness.
- Covered reception when needed.
- Escorted contractors on premises. 
- Maintained reports on all specified activity. 
- Received the Employee Of The Month award for responding to an emergency.

projects.title: Seattle Trails
projects.description: Official mobile apps for the Seattle Parks & Recreation Department. Find trails, share them with friends, report issues to help keep them maintained.

projects.title: Rouster iOS Application JSON API
projects.description: Rouster is an iOS application that gamifies your morning. Turning off your alarm requires that you walk a certain distance via pedometer functionality. Gain points for waking up on time.
